clips.title: The story
paras: At Stormwind's gates, General Marcus Jonathan guards the capital and weighs calls for aid from the kingdom's frontier settlements. A veteran of the Second War, he commands Stormwind Defense and oversees the garrison.

General Marcus Jonathan commands Stormwind's defense from horseback in the Valley of Heroes. He is the highest-ranking officer at the city gates and its first line of defense. During the Second War, he fought beside soldiers such as Reginald Windsor under General Turalyon. Now he must protect the capital while frontier towns, including Lakeshire, make increasingly desperate appeals for help.
